summary: ADVERSARIAL H002: 2 methods INVALIDATED. (1) HMM 2-state result is trivial — state duration=301 months (entire series), meaning no regime switching detected. (2) Bayesian poly2 is a spatial confound — poly2(lat,lon) fits random spatial fields at R²=0.55, so albedo's R²=0.62 is not evidence of physics. HOWEVER: attractor CD=1.86 SURVIVES — clearly below surrogates (2.32±0.04), confirming real low-D structure. H002 reduced from 5/5 to 3/5 confirming methods. No longer converged.
